subject: CLAIM+EDIT shader-coverage-opus: air_bridge.rs NEW export tegu_air_tile_pipeline_create (MTLTileRenderPipelineDescriptor -> translator compile_tile_pipeline), inserted before tegu_air_pipeline_create_ex
body: For QuartzCore tile_downsample_1/2/4/8 (CA kernels refusing 'needs pipeline input: TileAttachments'). Args: library,name,len, const uint32_t formats[8] (Metal pixel formats, 0 unset), raster_sample_count, threadgroup_size_matches_tile_size, profile, spirv, metadata, error. Returns the usual TeguAIRPipeline (creation compile only; dispatch-time compute variants not tile-aware). Runtime dispatch per tile (imageblock size / render area / tile attachment bindings) is not implemented.
